📺 American Sports Story: Aaron Hernandez (2024)

American Sports Story: Aaron Hernandez follows the shocking true story of Aaron Hernandez, a talented football player whose promising NFL career was destroyed by criminal allegations, violence, and personal struggles. Rising from a difficult childhood in Connecticut to becoming a star tight end for the New England Patriots, Hernandez appears to have everything an athlete could dream of—fame, wealth, and professional success. However, behind his public image, he struggles with complicated relationships, family trauma, and a secretive personal life. As his behavior becomes increasingly troubling, a murder investigation exposes a darker side of his world, leading to one of the most notorious scandals in professional football history. Starring Josh Andrés Rivera, the series delivers an intense and emotional portrayal of ambition, identity, fame, betrayal, and the devastating consequences of destructive decisions.

🎭 Genre: Crime • Biography • Drama • Sports

⭐ IMDb: 7.3/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 45–60 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Creator: Stu Zicherman

📺 Seasons: 1 • 10 Episodes

📚 Based On: The true story of former NFL player Aaron Hernandez and reporting from Gladiator: Aaron Hernandez and Football Inc.

📺 Where to Watch: Hulu in the United States.
